name: Engeki Kurabu -Yogoreta Curtain Call-
original_name: 艶劇倶楽部 -汚れたカーテンコール-
source:
Main character is born in a family of play writer and famous actress. But father dies from overwork, and protagonist is afraid to follow his steps even though theater world has big expectations of him.
He has no intention to continue the dynasty, and and he hates theater so much that he wants to destroy it all...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角出生在剧作家与著名女演员之家。然而，父亲因过劳去世；尽管戏剧界对他寄予厚望，他却害怕重蹈父亲覆辙。
他无意延续家业，甚至痛恨戏剧到了想把一切彻底摧毁的地步……

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
